title: Strike list
suits: before → after replacement claims: many tools, steps, apps or forms become one product; consolidation, simplification, 'you can stop doing these'

params.--field: the desk field (terracotta); text, strikes, pen ink and the ghost card use --ink-auto
params.--brand: the pen body, the mark tile, the check, board chips
params.__WORD__ / __MARK__: the bright card's header: it is the product
params..st-strike-list-row: a before item (glyph + word); keep 3–5, each --i in order

details: a marker pen rides each strike, pressing down, and lifts away between rows
the pen lands with a small ink dot where each line starts
every strike is drawn by hand, wavy, its own slant, overshooting the word on both ends
each row dims a beat after its line passes, not with it
the last pen lifts and stays hovering at the end of its line
the faded card is turned 2.5° like it has been on the desk a while, and sags a little more once all are struck
a dashed slot waits where the new card will land
the hand-drawn arrow is drawn on between the two cards
the bright card drops in tilted, squashes on landing, hops 8 px and settles
its shadow starts small and soft and catches up as it lands
the board's chips pop in after the landing and one chip slides from the first column to the second
three faces pop in one after another: the board is shared
a check stamps the corner and leaves a fading ring
a faint coffee ring on the desk
